sn55.28:1.1: atha kho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
sn55.28:1.2: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ bhagavā etadavoca:
sn55.28:1.3: yato ca kho gahapati, ariyasāvakassa pañca bhayāni verāni vūpasantāni honti, catūhi ca sotāpattiyaṅgehi samannāgato hoti, ariyo cassa ñāyo paññāya sudiṭṭho hoti suppaṭividdho, so ākaṅkhamāno attanāva attānaṃ vyākareyya:
sn55.28:1.4: “khīṇanirayomhi khīṇatiracchānayoniyo khīṇapettivisayo khīṇāpāyaduggativinipāto, sotāpanno‘hamasmi avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇo”.
sn55.28:2.1: katamāni pañca bhayāni verāni vūpasantāni honti:
sn55.28:2.2: yaṃ gahapati, pāṇātipātī pāṇātipātappaccayā diṭṭhadhammikampi bhayaṃ veraṃ pasavati, samparāyikampi bhayaṃ veraṃ pasavati, cetasikampi dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvediyati.
sn55.28:2.3: pāṇātipātā paṭiviratassa etaṃ bhayaṃ veraṃ vūpasantaṃ hoti.
sn55.28:2.7: yaṃ gahapati, surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhāyī surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānappaccayā diṭṭhadhammikampi bhayaṃ veraṃ pasavati, samparāyikampi bhayaṃ veraṃ pasavati, cetasikampi dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvediyati.
sn55.28:2.8: surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭiviratassa etaṃ bhayaṃ veraṃ vūpasantaṃ hoti.
sn55.28:2.9: imāni pañca bhayāni verāni vūpasantāni honti.
sn55.28:3.2: idha gahapati, ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti:
sn55.28:3.3: “itipi so bhagavā …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā”ti.
sn55.28:3.6: ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akhaṇḍehi …pe… samādhisaṃvattanikehi.
sn55.28:4.1: katamo cassa ariyo ñāyo paññāya sudiṭṭho hoti suppaṭividdho?
sn55.28:4.2: idha gahapati, ariyasāvako paṭiccasamuppādaṃ yeva sādhukaṃ yoniso manasikaroti:
sn55.28:4.3: “iti imasmiṃ sati idaṃ hoti, imassuppādā idaṃ uppajjati,
sn55.28:4.4: iti imasmiṃ asati idaṃ na hoti, imassa nirodhā idaṃ nirujjhati,
sn55.28:4.5: yadidaṃ avijjāpaccayā saṅkhārā, saṅkhārapaccayā viññāṇaṃ, viññāṇapaccayā nāmarūpaṃ nāmarūpapaccayā saḷāyatanaṃ, saḷāyatanapaccayā phasso, phassapaccayā vedanā, vedanā paccayā taṇhā, taṇhāpaccayā upādānaṃ, upādānapaccayā bhavo, bhavapaccayā jāti, jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇaṃ soka parideva dukkha domanassupāyāsā sambhavanti.
sn55.28:4.7: avijjāyatveva asesavirāganirodhā saṅkhāranirodho, saṅkhāranirodhā viññāṇanirodho, …pe… sokaparideva dukkhadomanassupāyāsā nirujjhanti.
sn55.28:4.9: ayamassa ariyo ñāyo paññāya sudiṭṭho hoti suppaṭividdho.
sn55.28:5.1: yato kho gahapati, ariyasāvakassa imāni pañca bhayāni verāni vūpasantāni honti, imehi catūhi sotāpattiyaṅgehi samannāgato hoti, ayamassa ariyo ñāyo paññāya sudiṭṭho hoti suppaṭividdho. so ākaṅkhamāno attanāva attānaṃ vyākareyya:
sn55.28:5.2: “khīṇanirayomhi khīṇatiracchānayoniyo khīṇapettivisayo khīṇāpāyaduggativinipāto, sotāpannohamasmi avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇo”ti.
